items.title: Ella
items.summary: Ella is a humanoid animatronic created by Henry Emily.  She resides in one of three closets in Charlotte's room, only coming out when a wheel is turned at the foot of her bed.

items.title: Baby Crawler
items.summary: The Baby Crawlers are minor antagonists in Five Nights at Freddy's: The Fourth Closet.  They serve as the alternate counterparts of the Bidybabs from Sister Location and one of the mascots at Circus Baby's Pizza.
